name: Cashbuild Limited
source: Annual consolidated financial statements for the 52 weeks ended 28 June 2026, audited by Deloitte and Touche with an unmodified opinion, consolidated statement of profit or loss, figures in Rand thousands scaled to units. FY2026 and FY2025 rebuilt from the filing: Revenue 12,113,105 less Cost of sales 9,046,829 equals Gross profit 3,066,276; selling and marketing 2,224,485 plus administrative 498,503 plus other operating expenses 67,521 gives Operating Expenses 2,790,509, and with other income 20,494 less impairment losses on trade receivables 4,669 the printed operating profit is 291,592; finance cost 158,829 less finance income 111,394 gives Net Finance Costs 47,435 and Profit before tax 244,157; income tax 71,247 gives profit for the year 172,910, of which 166,434 is attributable to owners of the parent and 6,476 to non-controlling interests. Basic earnings per share 786.1 cents. FY2024 and older retained from Yahoo Finance: no filing read for those years.

sourceAudit.document: Consolidated statement of profit or loss

netProfitBasis: Net Profit is the profit attributable to owners of the parent, the figure the printed basic earnings per share divides into. Profit for the year before non-controlling interest is recorded in profitForYear.
